decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits right next to the firm's core pipeline fittings, and it was promoted to its own page in 2019, so the firm can readily interpret results and improve it with its existing welding and coating knowledge.

Public waste bins are far from the firm's water-infrastructure knowledge base, and there is no evidence of its own R&D, so the firm has little related knowledge to learn from market feedback; only the use of its powder-coating capability argues for keeping it.

The waste bin with ashtray line is distant from the firm's established offer, which limits its absorptive capacity to assimilate customer and market information, although the several models signal some commitment and use of its coating capacity.

Outdoor ashtrays serve a street-furniture market unrelated to the firm's pipeline expertise, and without its own R&D the firm can hardly build on early results, so freeing resources for the core business is likely.
